units.source_zh: “这……先生不在家，出门了。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “这……先生不在家，出门了。”

paragraphs.source_en: “On a long journey?”

units.source_en: “On a long journey?”
units.source_zh: “远足？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “远足？”

paragraphs.source_en: “No. He will return in a day or two. I have already sent him a letter asking that he come to pay his respects as soon as he returns.”

units.source_en: “No.
He will return in a day or two.
units.source_zh: 一两日便回。

units.source_en: I have already sent him a letter asking that he come to pay his respects as soon as he returns.”
units.source_zh: 在下已着人送去信函，请他回后即来拜见。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “不。一两日便回。在下已着人送去信函，请他回后即来拜见。”

paragraphs.source_en: “I see.” Ieyasu stared fixedly at Katsushige. “Katsushige, I no longer wish to question that old fellow about O-Sen.”

units.source_en: “I see.”
Ieyasu stared fixedly at Katsushige. “Katsushige, I no longer wish to question that old fellow about O-Sen.”
units.source_zh: 家康目不转睛盯着胜重，“胜重，阿千之事，不想再问那老儿了。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “哦。”家康目不转睛盯着胜重，“胜重，阿千之事，不想再问那老儿了。”

paragraphs.source_en: “My lord...”

units.source_en: “My lord...”

paragraphs.source_en: “You deliberately told me he was not at home. Since that is so, I shall ask no more.”

units.source_en: “You deliberately told me he was not at home. Since that is so, I shall ask no more.”

ja.t: った。ならば、わしももう

units.source_zh: “你故意说他不在家，既然如此，我也就不想再问了。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “你故意说他不在家，既然如此，我也就不想再问了。”

paragraphs.source_en: “It does not matter. At times, a lie may be kindly meant. A man who is too unbendingly honest can instead be cruel. There, there. When Hon'ami comes, I shall praise him warmly, so do not worry...”

units.source_en: “It does not matter. At times, a lie may be kindly meant.
units.source_zh: “无妨，人有时说谎，亦是善意。

units.source_en: A man who is too unbendingly honest can instead be cruel.
units.source_zh: 人太刚直，反而冷酷。

units.source_en: There, there. When Hon'ami comes, I shall praise him warmly, so do not worry...”
units.source_zh: 好了好了，待本阿弥来了，我会好生褒奖他，不必忧心……”

paragraphs.source_zh: “无妨，人有时说谎，亦是善意。人太刚直，反而冷酷。好了好了，待本阿弥来了，我会好生褒奖他，不必忧心……”

paragraphs.source_en: Itakura Katsushige's shoulders shook as he burst into tears.

units.source_en: Itakura Katsushige's shoulders shook as he burst into tears.
units.source_zh: 板仓胜重颤抖着双肩，大哭。
